component.name: 8BitDo M30 Bluetooth Gamepad
component.summary: Firmware for the 8BitDo M30 Bluetooth Gamepad

description.p: Update your 8BitDo M30 Bluetooth Gamepad to the latest firmware version to enjoy improved performance, new features, and bug fixes.
重要提示：请尽快更新至此版本。更新完成后，无法降级或回滚至较早的固件版本。
本次更新包含以下优化与修复：

ul.li: 优化蓝牙连接的稳定性。

description.p: Important: Please update to this version as soon as possible. After updating, you cannot downgrade or roll back to an earlier firmware version.
This release includes the following improvements and fixes:

ul.li: Optimized the stability over Bluetooth connection.

screenshot.caption: Hold the Start button for 3 seconds to power off the controller, then press L + R + Start to enter update mode. The power indicator will flash, and then reconnect the controller.

custom.value: Important: After updating to version 2.00, you cannot downgrade or roll back to an earlier firmware version.
重要提示：更新至版本 2.00 后，无法降级或回滚至较早的固件版本。
